description: First-layer head-0 QK1 pre-RoPE rank-96 uniform/mixed/corpus cuts from unchanged seed-41 fit. Key-masked intervention at one naturally occurring rare (FineWeb train count 1–9) or common (count >=1000) token per disjoint held-out document; all other keys native. Three corpora, full 18-layer propagation, per-case suffix KL, CE change, and post-c_proj edit energy. Token-frequency selection uses only FineWeb train docs 0–14999. No fitting or prior selection on these cases.
